name: EA_TradingPanel
summary: A semi-automated trading panel EA that provides a graphical interface on the chart for manually placing buy and sell orders with configurable parameters. Users can set the number of trades, stop loss, take profit (in pips), volume, and symbol via the panel controls, then click BUY or SELL buttons to execute trades instantly at market price.
summary_zh: 一个半自动交易面板EA，在图表上提供图形界面，允许用户手动设置交易数量、止损、止盈（点数）、手数和交易品种，然后通过点击买入或卖出按钮即时执行市价单。
strategy_analysis: 该EA是一个交易面板工具，不包含自动策略逻辑，所有交易决策由用户手动触发。入场条件完全依赖用户点击BUY或SELL按钮，以当前Ask/Bid价市价入场。出场条件通过用户设定的SL和TP点数计算止损止盈价格，但SL/TP计算函数存在严重逻辑错误——SELL的SL用了dPriceTP函数、TP用了dPriceSL函数，方向完全颠倒。仓位管理方面，用户可通过SpinEdit控件设置1-20个连续订单，EA会循环下相同手数的多个订单，无任何仓位递减或加仓逻辑。资金管理完全依赖用户手动设置手数，EA本身没有任何风险控制机制如最大持仓检查、账户余额验证或最大回撤限制。此外，从UI控件读取SL/TP值时使用了`(double)ObjectGetString`强制类型转换，这在MQL5中不会正确将文本字符串转换为double数值，属于编程错误。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA is a trading panel utility with no automated strategy logic; all trading decisions are triggered manually by the user. Entry conditions rely entirely on the user clicking BUY or SELL buttons, executing market orders at the current Ask/Bid price. Exit conditions are calculated from user-specified SL and TP pip values, but the SL/TP calculation functions have a critical logic error — the SELL handler uses dPriceTP for SL and dPriceSL for TP, reversing the directions completely. For position sizing, the user can set 1-20 consecutive orders via the SpinEdit control, and the EA loops to place multiple identical-lot orders with no position reduction or scaling logic. Money management is entirely manual with the user setting the lot size; the EA itself has no risk control mechanisms such as maximum position checks, account balance validation, or maximum drawdown limits. Additionally, reading SL/TP values from UI controls uses `(double)ObjectGetString` forced type casting, which does not correctly convert text strings to double values in MQL5 — this is a programming error that would produce incorrect values at runtime.

parameters.name: dSL
parameters.description_en: Sell order stop loss in points

parameters.name: dTP
parameters.description_en: Sell order take profit in points

pros: 提供直观的图形交易面板，用户可快速手动下单
支持多品种选择，通过ComboBox可切换至Market Watch中任意交易品种
可一键批量下单（1-20笔），适合需要快速执行多笔相同交易的场景
pros_en: Provides an intuitive graphical trading panel for quick manual order placement
Supports multi-symbol selection via ComboBox, allowing switching to any symbol in Market Watch
Enables batch order placement (1-20 trades) with one click, useful for quickly executing multiple identical trades
cons: SL/TP计算函数在SELL按钮中调用颠倒，会导致止损止盈价格完全错误，可能造成严重亏损
从UI控件读取数值使用(double)ObjectGetString强制转换，MQL5中字符串到double的强制转换不会正确解析数字文本
无任何风险控制机制——无最大持仓检查、无账户余额验证、无最大回撤保护
OnInit中检测到已存在面板时返回INIT_SUCCEEDED但不创建面板，如果面板被意外关闭则无法恢复
所有图表颜色被强制设为白色（包括背景和前景），导致图表几乎不可用且无法自动恢复
cons_en: SL/TP calculation functions are called in reverse order in the SELL handler — dPriceTP is used for SL and dPriceSL for TP, which will produce completely wrong stop levels and could cause severe losses
Reading numeric values from UI controls uses (double)ObjectGetString forced casting, which does not correctly parse numeric text strings to double values in MQL5
No risk control mechanisms at all — no maximum position checks, no account balance validation, no maximum drawdown protection
OnInit returns INIT_SUCCEEDED when detecting an existing panel without recreating it, making recovery impossible if the panel is accidentally closed
All chart colors are forced to white (including background and foreground), rendering the chart nearly unusable with no automatic restoration
improvements: 修复SELL按钮中dPriceSL和dPriceTP的调用顺序，确保止损在入场价下方、止盈在入场价上方
使用StringToDouble()替代(double)强制转换来正确从UI控件文本中读取数值
添加风险控制机制：最大持仓限制、账户余额检查、滑点过滤和订单执行结果验证
improvements_en: Fix the reversed dPriceSL/dPriceTP calls in the SELL handler to ensure stop loss is below and take profit is above the entry price
Replace (double) forced casting with StringToDouble() to correctly parse numeric text from UI controls
Add risk control mechanisms: maximum position limits, account balance checks, spread filtering, and order execution result verification

risk_points: SELL按钮SL/TP计算逻辑颠倒，会导致止损被设在错误方向，可能造成无限亏损
UI控件数值读取使用错误的类型转换，可能导致手数、止损、止盈值为0或异常值
无订单执行结果检查，trade.Sell/trade.Buy返回值未验证
无最大持仓限制，用户可一次下20笔订单而无任何防护
risk_points_en: SELL button SL/TP calculation logic is reversed, which could place stops in the wrong direction and cause unlimited losses
UI control value reading uses incorrect type casting, potentially resulting in lot size, SL, or TP values of 0 or anomalous values
No order execution result checking — trade.Sell/trade.Buy return values are not verified
No maximum position limits — users can place up to 20 orders at once without any safeguards

summary_en: A semi-automated trading panel EA that provides a graphical interface on the chart for manually placing buy and sell orders with configurable parameters. Users can set the number of trades, stop loss, take profit (in pips), volume, and symbol via the panel controls, then click BUY or SELL buttons to execute trades instantly at market price.
